t: How the Cross-Database Schema Mapper works (Signature)
title: How the Cross-Database Schema Mapper works (Signature)
description: Signature record. Overview: what the Cross-Database Schema Mapper does and why archives need it. Signature original. The Signature method scores every candidate pair with frozen weights — name, type, and value evidence combined deterministically — so the same two schemas always yield the same proposed map. Each mapping carries its three evidence scores and the rule version, and human confirmations are stored as approval ledger entries layered over the machine's proposal. Re-mapping after a schema change diffs against the previous map. This is a Signature-authored method, original to Justin Addam Higgins.
